{
  "claim": "https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/claim/turing-wavelength",
  "source": "network",
  "nanopubs": [
    "https://w3id.org/np/RAjJiCpfgPzPI0Oidz7C5KIqYJuGw5iIhz-iukSDtzO08"
  ],
  "fields": {
    "rdf:type": [
      "https://w3id.org/delphi/ontology/Claim",
      "https://w3id.org/delphi/ontology/TestableHypothesis"
    ],
    "rdfs:label": "Turing wavelength selection",
    "dct:description": "The spacing of a Turing pattern at onset is set by the reaction rates and diffusivities, not by the size of the tissue, so changing these parameters predictably changes the number of repeated elements.",
    "rdfs:seeAlso": [
      "https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1226804",
      "https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1252960"
    ],
    "dct:source": "Alan Turing (1952) The chemical basis of morphogenesis",
    "delphi:context": "Assumptions: near onset of instability, two species, domain large compared with the wavelength. Formal status: proved by linear analysis. Away from onset, the selected wavelength depends on nonlinear terms and history.",
    "delphi:hypothesisType": "model-theorem",
    "delphi:proposedTest": "Alter morphogen production, degradation or diffusion in a developing tissue (e.g. Hox dosage or Bmp/Wnt inhibition in mouse limb buds) and test whether digit or element number changes in the direction and proportion the dispersion relation predicts.",
    "skos:notation": "at onset k_c^2 = \\sqrt{\\det J/(D_u D_v)}, \\lambda_c = 2\\pi/k_c; under uniform rescaling of D, \\lambda \\propto \\sqrt{D}"
  },
  "assessments": []
}
